title: UA mitigates cisplatin-induced toxicity suggesting involvement of the KEAP1-NRF2 pathway: insights from histopathological validation, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究熊果酸对顺铂毒性的保护作用，涉及KEAP1-NRF2蛋白复合物的分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cisplatin is a widely used chemotherapeutic agent known for its potent antitumor activity, however its clinical use is significantly limited by dose-dependent multiorgan toxicity predominantly affecting the kidney, heart and reproductive organs, with mechanisms involving oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammation and apoptosis. In this study the potential protective effects of ursolic acid (UA), a pentacyclic triterpenoid with known antioxidant and antiapoptotic properties, against cisplatin-induced organ toxicity was explored. Thirty Swiss albino mice were randomly divided into five groups including control, cisplatin-treated, cisplatin + low-dose UA, cisplatin + high-dose UA and UA alone, with cisplatin (10 mg/kg, i.p.) given as a single dose and UA administered daily for 14 days, and kidney, heart and testis tissues were examined histologically showing that cisplatin caused glomerular and tubular degeneration, myocardial disarray with inflammatory infiltration and degeneration of seminiferous tubules, while UA co-administration significantly reduced these histopathological alterations in a dose-dependent manner, and serum reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels confirmed its antioxidant potential, and further molecular docking followed by 200 ns molecular dynamic simulations in GROMACS targeting the KEAP1-NRF2 complex (PDB ID: 2FLU) showed strong binding of UA (-7.2 kcal/mol), comparable to curcumin supporting a possible role in NRF2 activation, and simulation analysis demonstrated that both UA-KEAP1 and curcumin-KEAP1 complexes formed stable interactions with UA exhibiting slightly lower RMSD fluctuations and consistent radius of gyration values indicating a compact and dynamically stable complex, suggesting that UA may offer protection against cisplatin-induced toxicity by modulating oxidative stress and the KEAP1-NRF2 pathway.
abstract_zh: 顺铂是一种广泛使用的化疗药物，以其强效抗肿瘤活性而闻名，但其临床应用受到剂量依赖性多器官毒性的显著限制，主要影响肾脏、心脏和生殖器官，其机制涉及氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、炎症和细胞凋亡。本研究探讨了熊果酸（UA），一种具有已知抗氧化和抗凋亡特性的五环三萜类化合物，对顺铂诱导的器官毒性的潜在保护作用。将三十只瑞士白化小鼠随机分为五组，包括对照组、顺铂处理组、顺铂+低剂量UA组、顺铂+高剂量UA组和单独UA组，其中顺铂（10 mg/kg，腹腔注射）单次给药，UA每日给药持续14天，并对肾脏、心脏和睾丸组织进行组织学检查，结果显示顺铂导致肾小球和肾小管变性、心肌紊乱伴炎症浸润及生精小管变性，而UA联合给药以剂量依赖性方式显著减轻了这些组织病理学改变，血清活性氧（ROS）水平证实了其抗氧化潜力，进一步通过分子对接及在GROMACS中针对KEAP1-NRF2复合物（PDB ID: 2FLU）进行的200 ns分子动力学模拟显示，UA具有强结合力（-7.2 kcal/mol），与姜黄素相当，支持其在NRF2激活中的可能作用，模拟分析表明UA-KEAP1和姜黄素-KEAP1复合物均形成稳定相互作用，其中UA表现出略低的RMSD波动和一致的回旋半径值，表明其形成紧凑且动态稳定的复合物，提示UA可能通过调节氧化应激和KEAP1-NRF2通路来提供对顺铂诱导毒性的保护作用。
